scope: Native Fountain browser editor in the actual GitLab application; partial toolbar/providers, not full product acceptance
checks: Normal web sign-in and authenticated API version match the image/source pin
Real private project, PNG upload and issue created through authenticated GitLab HTTP APIs
Real browser clipboard Markdown renders through the actual GitLab service, inserts with reference/marks, and supports one-step undo/redo
An actual unsupported GitLab-rendered footnote leaves the document untouched, exposes exact retained source and recovers through a later supported paste
Actual GitLab-rendered multiline highlighted code imports, changes language and restores through one-step undo/redo
Real browser clipboard copies the complete code source; invalid/custom drafts and Escape preserve the code and restore editor focus
Delete removes the full code block, undo restores it, and actual browser typing edits the restored code in place
Actual nested code deletion/undo/redo retains its list and neighboring item; browser typing lands in the replacement paragraph
Native Fountain toolbar formats actual browser selection; undo and redo update both document and view
Rebuilt real host hands current rich content to source mode and reopens it without a stale cached value
Native UI Save persists the changed code language and exact source; the actual GitLab reader renders the edited code
Native rich typing and UI save persisted the added paragraph and retained the seeded content in the server record
An actual empty comment paints its placeholder, hides it on focus/typing and restores empty state after real comment persistence
An initially empty native Fountain composer creates a real GitLab discussion comment and clears after successful persistence
Actual unsupported saved Markdown refuses editing through Retry; explicit recovery enables a local draft, cancelled without changing the server original
Private issue is unavailable to an unauthenticated browser context
Exact saved server source, authenticated session and uploaded image survive an actual application-container restart
secrets: Password/session used in memory only; no traces or storage-state files

nativeRuntime.scope: Native Fountain/GitLab integration runtime; not a deployed or complete GitLab replacement
